---
title: "Catalog Explorer"
---

Catalog Explorer browses supported catalog-backed data sources. Use its tree to navigate namespaces and inspect tables, views, and fields without manually entering every identifier.

Refresh the relevant node after external schema changes. Opening or previewing data uses the capabilities and permissions of the configured catalog connection.

Metadata visibility does not imply write access. Confirm the selected catalog, namespace, and account before running generated or copied queries.
